h1: Na Care Hotel Chaiyaphum — a new hotel with a pool, clean rooms, near Robinson, in the thousand-baht range
intro: If you're in Chaiyaphum and want a newer hotel with clean rooms, a pool to cool off in, and a central spot near the mall that's easy to drive around from — Na Care Hotel is a name that keeps coming up. It's a 3-star hotel that only opened in 2024, with 49 rooms in the Nai Mueang subdistrict, just about 3 minutes from the Robinson junction, with an outdoor pool, free parking and an on-site restaurant. Rates start at around ฿850/night. The trade-off the reviews flag is noise from the hallways and neighbouring rooms at times, and breakfast that's sometimes served lukewarm.

body.html: What sets Na Care Hotel apart from many stays in central Chaiyaphum is simply how new it is. It only opened in 2024, so the rooms, furnishings and bathrooms are all still fresh. Real reviews mention clean, nicely decorated rooms most often, and the cleanliness scores on the booking platforms are high. Rooms come with air-con, an Android TV and a full set of bathroom amenities, all laid out tidily the way a just-opened hotel tends to be.

Another thing guests like is that there's an outdoor pool with a children's section — not something you find often in a central Chaiyaphum stay at this price. Several reviews call the pool clean and good for letting kids cool off. There's free on-site parking, so self-drivers can park easily, plus a 24-hour reception and a lift, which makes late arrivals and carrying bags upstairs no trouble.

The location is in the Nai Mueang subdistrict, just about 3 minutes from the Robinson junction. That makes it easy to pop to the mall, grab food, or pick up something before heading back to your room, and you can drive to the government district and the town market in a few minutes. It works well for people in town for business or paperwork, and for travellers using Chaiyaphum as a base before driving out to the Siam tulip fields or Tat Ton Waterfall.
"New hotel, clean rooms, nicely decorated, a pool for the kids, free parking out front, near Robinson so easy to drive out for food — for just over a thousand baht it's good value for Chaiyaphum."

To be straight about it, the complaint that shows up in the reviews is noise. Some guests hear the hallways and neighbouring rooms from inside their room, especially when there's a function or activity near the pool in the evening. If noise keeps you up, ask for a room set further back, away from the main corridor or not facing the pool, right at check-in.

One more thing to set expectations on is breakfast. It's included in some rates and plenty of guests find it tasty, but a few reviews mention some items arriving lukewarm. It's the kind of small wrinkle you get at a newly opened hotel still fine-tuning its kitchen — and if it matters to you, there are restaurants in town just a few minutes' drive away.

Overall, Na Care Hotel scores 8.7 out of 10 on Trip.com from around 21 real reviews (Booking.com gives it about 8.6). It's a strong fit for anyone who wants a newer hotel with clean rooms, a pool, free parking and a central spot near the mall, in the thousand-baht range. Rates start around ฿850 and rise with the season and room type. If you can live with some noise at times, it offers good value for the price in Chaiyaphum.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Na Care Hotel Chaiyaphum

faq.q: Where is Na Care Hotel in Chaiyaphum, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Na Care Hotel is at 207 Moo 13, Nai Mueang, Mueang Chaiyaphum. It's a city-centre hotel just about 3 minutes from the Robinson junction, near the Chao Pho Phaya Lae Monument and the town market, with the government district and bus station a few minutes' drive away.

faq.q: How much does Na Care Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿850/night for a Standard King. Choices run from Superior King up to Superior Twin (two single beds). All rooms are air-conditioned with an Android TV. Prices rise with the season and room type — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Na Care Hotel have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's an outdoor swimming pool with a children's section, and free parking. The pool is a favourite with families bringing kids — if swimming is a priority, check with the hotel ahead that the pool is open to guests as usual during your stay.

faq.q: Is Na Care Hotel a new hotel, and what are the rooms like?
faq.a: Yes, it's new — Na Care Hotel only opened in 2024, so the rooms, furnishings and bathrooms are all still fresh. Real reviews mention the cleanliness and nice decor most often, with air-con, an Android TV and a full set of amenities. The thing to set expectations on is noise from the hallways and neighbouring rooms at times.

faq.q: Who is Na Care Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a good fit for anyone who wants a newer hotel with clean rooms, a pool and a central spot near the mall in Chaiyaphum, in the thousand-baht range — families with kids (there's a children's pool), business travellers, and tourists using Chaiyaphum as a base before the Siam tulip fields or Tat Ton Waterfall.

faq.q: Does Na Care Hotel have a noise problem?
faq.a: The most common complaint in the reviews is noise from the hallways and neighbouring rooms, especially during a function or activity near the pool in the evening. If noise keeps you up, ask for a room set further back, away from the main corridor or not facing the pool, at check-in.
